Players Committee card image of [[Dice Ibegon (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Power +2 at a Jabba's Palace or Endor site. If just lost, place Dice in Used Pile. if opponent is about to draw destiny for an Interrupt targeting your character here, opponent must first lose 1 Force then shuffle their Reserve Deck.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/diceibegon.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
